The exact original Poll(0), same held creator handle, invocation/descriptor predicates, exact live/exit tests and unknown behavior are preserved. HUP/combined flags are not reclassified.

Failure evidence adds creatorPoll. Missing/consumed/malformed inputs have no poll count/bits, not_observed category and empty coldInvocationId. No IDs or arbitrary error text are added.

The existing real stdin-gated owned-child control asserts live count0/bits0 and unreaped exit count1/exactPOLLIN, then checked sole Wait/consumed-close as before. It verifies unobserved missing/malformed/consumed facts and absence of identity in serialization.
limits: No control executed or actual historical unknown poll reconstructed.
The original failed run remains unknown; future facts can classify one observation but grant no readiness or signal authority.
Original control cleanup and three-second context remain unchanged.
